Title: Sevenus Swimming baby and toddler classes, Chiswick
Address: 11 Wilson Walk, off Prebend Gardens, Stamford Brook
ScheduleText: Weekday baby and toddler sessions 9:00–15:00 (Dinghy parent-and-child level), then Skipper, Clipper, Schooner and Regatta levels. Monthly membership
Description: Long-running swim club with a warm (32–33°C) UV-treated pool; parent-and-child classes from about 3 months, small groups
NeedsInfo: Prices not on the website (directories show £13–£19 a class). Exact class times via the members portal

Title: Gliders swimming lessons at Mount Carmel pool, Ealing
Address: Mount Carmel RC Primary School pool, Little Ealing Lane, Ealing
ScheduleText: Regular lessons Tuesdays and Thursdays in small groups; crash courses in school holidays
Description: Family-run, inclusive swim school (mother and daughter) in a warm school pool
NeedsInfo: Lesson times and ages not listed on the home page; book via the parent portal

Title: Freaky Friday Halloween family splash – Gliders, Mount Carmel pool
Address: Mount Carmel RC Primary School pool, Little Ealing Lane, Ealing
ScheduleText: Friday 30 October 13:45–14:45, then face painting and treats
PriceText: £22 for 1 adult + 1 child; extra adult £7, extra child £10

Title: Half-term family swim – Gliders, Mount Carmel pool
